questions.title: Merge Sort Strategy
questions.description: What is merge sort's divide-and-conquer strategy?
questions.Option1: Split the list into halves, sort each half, then merge the two sorted halves
questions.Option2: Pick a pivot and partition the elements around it
questions.Option3: Swap adjacent out-of-order pairs until no swaps remain
questions.Option4: Repeatedly select the minimum and move it to the front

questions.title: Merge Sort Complexity
questions.description: What is merge sort's time complexity in the best, average and worst cases?
questions.Option4: O(n log n) in every case

questions.Option2: By definition, the value at the middle index
questions.Option3: The element used to split the list into values that go before it and values that go after it
questions.Option4: The element that always ends up last after partitioning

questions.Option1: O(n) — for the temporary arrays used while merging

questions.title: Snippet Lomuto Pass
questions.description: The pivot is 5 (value at index 3). What does this print?
questions.codesnippet:
nums = [3, 8, 2, 5]
p = nums[3]
i = -1
for j in range(3):
    if nums[j] <= p:
        i += 1
        nums[i], nums[j] = nums[j], nums[i]
nums[i + 1], nums[3] = nums[3], nums[i + 1]
print(nums)

questions.Option4: Neither algorithm can ever be stable

questions.title: Snippet Smallest Pivot
questions.description: The pivot is nums[4] = 2, the smallest value. What does this print?
questions.codesnippet:
nums = [4, 7, 3, 6, 2]
pivot = nums[4]
store = 0
for j in range(4):
    if nums[j] <= pivot:
        nums[store], nums[j] = nums[j], nums[store]
        store += 1
print(store, nums[store])

questions.title: Timsort on Sorted Data
questions.description: What makes Timsort fast on an already-sorted list?
questions.Option1: It always needs about n log n comparisons, sorted or not
questions.Option2: It shuffles the list first to balance the work
questions.Option3: It degrades to O(n^2) on sorted input
questions.Option4: It detects existing ascending runs, so a fully sorted list is handled in about O(n)
